text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nooo! I don't wanna go home yet!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho and I are in a bit of a situation after a day out.
choice_data_list: But we really need to head back.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But why? It's not even dark yet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I wanna keep going and I wanna eat something sweet!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: The witching hour is only just starting! I'm not going back! No way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm glad she had a good time today, but we need to get back soon, or it'll interfere with her plans later.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Hey, come and get me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, I notice some children that seem to be trying to squeeze in every last bit of fun they can before they each have to head home.
choice_data_list: All right, let's have some fun!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph! That's what you shoulda said from the start!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let's just get to the tr—
choice_data_list: I'm gonna go talk to those kids real quick.
I'm gonna go talk to those kids real quick.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I ask the children if we can join their game and they gladly agree. However…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No! I don't wanna play any kiddie games!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: She's not gonna play? Okay, let's keep racing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Humph… Hrm… GRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be getting more and more upset. I wonder how I can get her to enjoy herself…

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Hey, can you break off this branch? I wanna make a sword.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Making swords sounds like something Sweep Tosho would want to join in on!
choice_data_list: Looks like we might need some magic…
Looks like we might need some magic…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …! Did someone say magic?

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: No, I just need a grown-up to break it off for me.
choice_data_list: Oh! But we've got a witch right here!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Huh? You can use magic?

text_block_list.name: Child C
text_block_list.text: Wow! That's amazing! I wanna see! Show us! Show us!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
choice_data_list: Will you cast a spell for everyone?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fine! I guess I can if you really want me to! ♪♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Powerful dimorphotheca! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crack!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Wow, you made two swords! How did you split it so perfectly?! It really was like magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because it really is magic! I found a weak point and concentrated my magic there!
choice_data_list: (Well, it was more the power of her hands than magic…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, I've enchanted this sword with magical power. Take good care of it!

text_block_list.name: Child B
text_block_list.text: Um… Yeah… I will, thanks…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That puts Sweep Tosho in a good mood and she plays with everyone after!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm tired. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What magic circle?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …You mean those hopscotch circles?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho points to a long stretch of circles that some children scribbled on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Those were just drawn by some kids. They don't have any power.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What?
choice_data_list: The person who drew those is actually a witch that lives around here.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? Tell me more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to her that the circles have been enchanted to give you more strength the more you cross them.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you suuure?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I guess there's only one way to find out. What's the order you have to jump?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Hop, hop, hop…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Wow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! I feel jam-packed with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait a second… This is really magic! Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They aren't really enchanted, but it looks like there might have been a placebo effect. She seems to be in a good mood.
choice_data_list: (Now we just need to get back to the academy…)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What's going on? I feel like all my strength is draining…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, I get it! These magic circles aren't complete!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So do something about it, Familiar! They're losing their magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hurry! Move your butt!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Okay, so next is that white spot?! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come up with the idea to continue the path of magical circles along the white parts of the crosswalk… and successfully bring her back to campus.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wait, they stopped! Where's the next magic circle?!
